normative_encoding.provider: UNSELECTED; unsupported Ed25519 provider requires a new reviewed contract, no algorithm fallback
normative_encoding.signature: Unpadded base64url of exactly 64 Ed25519 signature bytes; canonical encoding only
normative_encoding.key_id: lowercase SHA-256 hex of raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key; pinned root chain and explicit key usage still required
normative_encoding.signing_input: UTF-8 ASCII prefix SQL002 followed by one NUL byte, then UTF-8 RFC8785 JCS of object with exactly protected and payload keys; signature excluded
normative_encoding.manifest_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS manifest object without envelope
normative_encoding.authorization_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS complete authorization envelope including signature
normative_encoding.other_envelope_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS complete envelope including signature
normative_encoding.strict_json: Reject recursively duplicated decoded keys, unknown keys, invalid Unicode, nonfinite numbers, extra values, absent required fields and null unless explicitly allowed; no trailing data except JSON whitespace
normative_encoding.wire_integer_policy: All counters, lengths, quotas and Unix seconds are decimal ASCII strings matching 0 or nonzero digit followed by digits; maximum 18446744073709551615; reject leading zeros, signs, fractions and overflow; increment at maximum rejects
normative_encoding.opaque_ids: authorization_id, admission_id, transaction_id, event_id, job_id and pin_id: lowercase 64-hex; generated by trusted services, not accepted as authority from producer
normative_encoding.booleans: Only native explicit true/false where specified; missing/null/string/numeric are invalid
normative_encoding.bounds: Default reject unless owner policy supplies maximum bytes/count/rate/TTL and verifier parser resource limits; no unspecified unlimited defaults

manifest.path_policy: Exact ASCII names above only; no slash, backslash, dot traversal, symlink, hardlink, mount escape, duplicate role/path or extra payload file
manifest.sidecar_bytes: ASCII catalog SHA-256 followed by two spaces then catalog.json then one LF; digest must equal catalog file entry
manifest.context_policy: Versioned owner-approved context schema and independent deterministic derivation rule from same catalog/job required; signer validates references and semantics, not hashes alone; absent schema/recipe denies
manifest.generation_id: Exactly manifest_digest; generation identity is content graph root, not a self field
manifest.genesis_previous: 64 zero hex digits only for explicitly owner-provisioned sequence-zero genesis; all ordinary requests require existing parent and sequence=current+1
manifest.metadata_rule: Manifest bytes and authorization envelope are verified separately by digest; any unexpected metadata path rejects or stays outside generation root in protected service storage; none enters its own digest

delegation.rule: Reusable bounded grant; does not contain one-use authorization ID or candidate digest; cannot change policy/epoch or authorize recovery

admission.rule: Issued only after independent trusted trigger/content admission; agent declarations or arbitrary callback evidence insufficient; ACS stores immutable admission and rechecks at commit

exact_required_fields.audience: identifier equal configured ACS commit service

authorization.rule: Signer key from protected header must equal active delegated signer; workload identity, admission, exact manifest and all resource limits independently checked; issuer key not duplicated in payload

storage_prepared.rule: Service assertion, not independent power-failure proof; key cannot sign generation authorization or policy

commit_event.rule: Event payload durably created in same ACS transaction as membership and ID consumption; envelope may be produced later from outbox

ack.rule: Durable readiness, not proof client received token or that software/runtime provenance is established

chain_validation.references: Verify exact canonical envelope digests: authorization admission_digest and delegation_digest; admission delegation_digest; every signature under pinned root chain and correct typed key usage
chain_validation.dataset_join: trust_domain, workspace_id and dataset_id equal across delegation, admission, authorization, manifest and prepared evidence
chain_validation.identity_join: authorization admission_id/job_id/workload_principal equal admission admission_id/job_id/principal_id; admission principal_id equals delegation principal_id; authenticated workload subject equals that principal and job
chain_validation.scope_join: admission and authorization reference same delegation; admission recipe_digest/schema_digest equal delegation; independently validated manifest uses that recipe/schema; exact permitted operation, paths, bytes, counts and aggregate quota cannot widen delegation
chain_validation.artifact_join: authorization generation_id and manifest_digest equal computed manifest digest; admission manifest_digest same; authorization parent/sequence equal manifest and ACS current-parent/next-sequence check; prepared evidence matches exact authorization envelope digest and all represented artifact fields
chain_validation.policy_join: policy_digest and authority_epoch equal across delegation, admission and authorization and current ACS policy; root/delegation/signer active at transaction serialization
chain_validation.audience_join: delegation, admission and authorization audience all equal independently configured ACS commit-service identity; signer-channel authentication has a separate configured audience not supplied by candidate
chain_validation.time_join: Trusted commit time lies within every delegation/admission/authorization interval, with not_before <= now < expires_at; authorization interval is subset of both delegation and admission intervals and within delegated maximum TTL; overflow/clock uncertainty rejects
chain_validation.failure: Any missing or unequal join denies; separately valid envelopes cannot be mixed

evidence_digest_refinement.previous_event_digest: SHA-256 of JCS unsigned preceding COMMIT payload; all-zero genesis only
evidence_digest_refinement.commit_event_digest: SHA-256 of fixed complete signed COMMIT envelope
evidence_digest_refinement.retry: T07 durably stores one canonical envelope before first export and retransmits exact bytes across rotation/restart; no re-signing a stored event
evidence_digest_refinement.ack_binding: ACK references that envelope digest and independent log receipt for exactly that envelope/event ID; log checks unsigned payload digest too

storage_incarnation_refinement.registration: ACS preparation record additionally binds never-reused object incarnation, transaction ID, physical object identity and fence
storage_incarnation_refinement.gc: Grant binds exact aborted transaction/registration/incarnation; storage serializes deletion/retirement/reuse and forbids digest path reuse until old grants durably retired; exact incarnation rechecked under lock before deletion
storage_incarnation_refinement.prepared_evidence_binding: Incarnation registration record is included in local_intent_digest and prepared ACS registration, not producer-supplied metadata

policy_enforcement.clock: ACS authoritative bounded clock; owner skew/TTL parameters unset; backward/uncertain time denies new authority decisions
policy_enforcement.revocation: T09 and T05 serialized in ACS; exact epoch/policy match required at T05; no precommit grandfathering
policy_enforcement.policy_storage: Authenticated owner updates, strict schema, monotonic epoch and independent protected checkpoint; producer cannot choose root or policy
policy_enforcement.quotas: Atomic aggregate quota charge and job/authorization consumption at T05; replay returns same result without recharge; aborted IDs never reused
policy_enforcement.historical_membership: Commit-time valid signature plus fresh ACS eligible committed membership; signature/expiry alone insufficient
policy_enforcement.compromise_default: Quarantine all generations authorized by compromised key since activation pending independently evidenced owner review; do not erase committed history
policy_enforcement.root_compromise: Stop admissions; separately provisioned out-of-band recovery authority required; never automatic trust-on-first-use reset
policy_enforcement.key_rotation: Owner-only versioned update, old/new key possession and authenticated trust distribution; ordinary rotation does not retroactively invalidate eligible committed data

scope_limits.receipt_schemas: Independent log, root-policy update and provider identity wire protocols require separately reviewed provider adapters; no implicit acceptance of arbitrary receipts. COMMIT/ACK/storage/authorization envelopes above are normative design contracts.
scope_limits.activation: DENIED until owner parameters, provider adapters, schemas, principal isolation and platform qualification are independently reviewed and separately authorized
scope_limits.test_vectors: REQUIRED_NOT_EXECUTED: canonical envelope, algorithm mismatch, cross-domain/key-use confusion, Unicode/number/path rejection, signature exclusion, missing/null/duplicate fields, in-scope malicious request, clock rollback, quota concurrency, revoked epoch and replay
